    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    anchor_rows = [r for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    target_top = min(anchor_rows)
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for color in {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}:
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        shift = target_top - min(r for r, _ in cells)
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r + shift][c] = color
    return out
